chapters.name: Final learned graph
chapters.zh: 最终图 · 四条保留边

scope_en: One custom Balance task-state discovery run: supervised visual-anchor repair, operated-value affine calibration, then frozen pixel-based revisable graph scoring. 48 observations, 12 rounds and 124 intervention trials; calibration uses 88 separate trials and fresh interface confirmation uses 96 trials. Both pre- and post-calibration task-state accuracy were 100% on confirmation, so this is not a calibration-benefit comparison. Continuous beam–ball feedback is retained physically; the displayed graph uses the declared task states. Not a new paper benchmark result or independent integrity certification.
scope_zh: 一组自建 Balance 任务状态图发现记录：监督视觉锚点修复、操作值仿射校准，再用冻结的像素接口进行可撤回图评分。48次观测、12轮共124次干预；校准另使用88次试验，独立接口确认使用96次试验。确认集上校准前后的任务状态准确率均为100%，因此不是校准收益对照。物理上的梁–球反馈仍然存在，展示的图采用已定义的任务状态；不作为新增论文基准结果或独立完整性认证。
legend_en: Blue: retained; green: added; red dashed: withdrawn; faint dashed: lower relative support. Colors describe graph updates, not reference correctness.
legend_zh: 蓝色：保留；绿色：新增；红色虚线：撤回；浅色虚线：相对支持较低。颜色表示图更新，不表示与参考真图的对错。
privacy: Public media and sanitized timing/scope only. Research code, weights, raw acquisitions and full run records remain private.
